digest.component_or_area: Jira adapters (Cloud vs Data Center) reconciliation test suite
propositions: Cloud and Data Center Jira adapters lack symmetric test coverage despite sharing backend logic: Cloud has ADF/comment/description depth tests from production incidents while DC has pagination/rate-limiting/TLS tests from controlled testing

DC adapter's whole-project readers and comment/description length convergence have never been characterized by pinned byte-for-byte values, only shape-contract tests, creating latent defect risk before shipping DC functionality
A duplicated ticket-type field map exists across adapters and must be single-sourced with anti-regression guards matching the existing status/priority map pattern
Five vacuous tests in the suite have unclear intent and must either assert their documented contract or be renamed to reflect actual behavior

Cloud and DC correctly diverge in text encoding (ADF vs wiki) and identity form (accountId vs name) but these divergences must be explicitly parametrized with different expected values rather than asserted as sameness
